jobs.description:
We are looking for a glass installer for a leading window and door company in Anzegem. In this role, you will assemble high-quality, durable custom-made aluminum and PVC products.

• You have a technical education or relevant experience in construction
• You work with precision and have a sharp eye for detail
• You think logically to solve problems during installation
• You handle stress well and stay calm when working with fragile glass
• You can work independently and make your own decisions
• You speak fluent Dutch or English

• You install various types of glass panels into aluminum windows and doors
• You inspect the quality of the products before they are shipped
• You report directly to the aluminum production manager

Bedrijfsomschrijving 

This company repackages and stores frozen and chilled food products for numerous European businesses. These services are tailored to the specific needs of each customer. By 2025, the company aims to employ more than 300 people, who together handle 25,000 unique packaging orders. Working for this company means being part of a respectful environment where strong teamwork and dedication to the job go hand in hand.

Your responsibilities as a Reach Truck Operator include:

 
• 
Carrying out inspections and checks on incoming and outgoing goods.

 
• 
Placing incoming products in the correct locations within the warehouse and preparing outgoing goods for shipment.

 
• 
Scanning products into the system once they have been stored in the appropriate location.

 
• 
Primarily operating a reach truck, while also being comfortable using a forklift truck and pallet truck when required.

Interested? Read on to find out if you qualify!

 
• 
You hold a valid reach truck certificate.

 
• 
You already have some experience operating a reach truck. Stacking goods up to 10 meters high does not intimidate you.

 
• 
You are able to communicate in English with your colleagues.

 
• 
You will be working in a frozen warehouse at -18°C, operating an enclosed, heated reach truck. Appropriate protective clothing will also be provided by the company.

For our client, we are looking for a motivated car body technician who enjoys working with vehicles and is not afraid to get hands-on.

You will join an experienced team in a car body repair company specialized in accident damage repairs.
What will you do?
• Disassemble vehicle body parts 
• Reassemble car components after repairs 
• Work on vehicles damaged in accidents 
• Use basic tools (screws, bolts, removing and reattaching parts) 
What do we expect from you?
• Experience with cars or bodywork is an advantage 
• Strong work ethic and motivation to work 
• Careful and precise approach to tasks 
• A team player with a humble attitude Languages
• No knowledge of Dutch required 
• Basic English is sufficient for communication 
• The team already includes international workers (including Polish and Albanian colleagues)

jobs.occupation: Senior Drone Project Manager – Operations & Regulatory Compliance
jobs.description:
Responsibilities

• Execute SORA and other comprehensive risk analyses to support large-scale drone operations.
• Define technical requirements for BVLOS flights, including mapping, photogrammetry, and structural infrastructure inspections.
• Manage the end-to-end project lifecycle from initial feasibility studies to final commissioning and as-built documentation.
• Coordinate multi-disciplinary stakeholders across connectivity, cybersecurity, and operational maintenance teams.
• Develop automated test scripts and integrate results into specialized monitoring and reporting systems.
• Ensure the quality of implemented solutions through custom test scenarios and rigorous documentation of anomalies.

Requirements

• You possess 5+ years of experience in drone piloting including VLOS and BVLOS operations with a valid STS certification.
• You have 5+ years of experience as a drone pilot instructor.
• You bring 5+ years of experience integrating drone video streams into Milestone platforms.
• You have 2+ years of experience with drone regulations and SORA risk assessment methodologies.
• You possess 2+ years of experience in network engineering and monitoring tool integration.
• You have 2+ years of experience in vendor negotiation and drafting technical specifications for public procurement procedures.
• You have experience using SAP for reporting and asset management.
• You are analytical, proactive, and demonstrate strong solution-oriented problem-solving skills.
• You are fluent in French and Dutch with a professional level of English.
Nice to Haves

• Experience with 4G or 5G connectivity solutions for remote drone operations.
• Knowledge of on-premise technical solution implementations.

Responsibilities

• Collect and formalize business requirements into detailed functional specifications.
• Collaborate with the Product Owner to manage the backlog and draft user stories.
• Coordinate functional testing and validate software deliveries with business stakeholders.
• Support development teams in understanding complex functional requirements.
• Analyze application incidents and prioritize necessary corrections.
• Facilitate Agile ceremonies and workshops to streamline project communication.

Requirements

• 5+ years of experience as a Functional Analyst within a software development environment.
• 5+ years of practical experience with Agile and Scrum methodologies, including Jira Agile and Confluence.
• 5+ years of experience in incident analysis, solution follow-up, and bug prioritization.
• 2+ years of experience with containerization using Docker, Kubernetes, and OpenShift.
• 2+ years of experience with SQL databases and Hazelcast.
• 2+ years of experience with Xray for test management.
• 2+ years of experience with TIBCO RDV (Rendezvous).
• 2+ years of experience with Java development tools.
• You possess a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science and are willing to participate in a 24/7 on-call rotation.
• You are fluent in Dutch or French (C2 level) with C1 level proficiency in the second national language and English.
Nice to Haves

• Knowledge of Eclipse RCP or Angular frontends.

The hiring organization is a leading multinational food manufacturing company. They run industrial-scale food manufacturing operations with high-volume production lines, warehouse and logistics systems, and strong reliance on ERP, MES, and automation technologies

Jobomschrijving

IT Infrastructure & Operations

• Lead and manage all day-to-day IT operations across manufacturing and office environments.
• Ensure high availability, performance, and security of network, server, cloud, and end-user computing infrastructure.
• Manage IT vendors, service providers, and technology partners.
• Establish and maintain disaster recovery, backup, and business continuity plans.
• Drive infrastructure modernization and technology improvement initiatives.

ERP & Enterprise Applications

• Act as the primary IT owner for ERP and business applications.
• Support, enhance, and optimize ERP processes across Finance, Procurement, Inventory, Warehouse, Production, and Supply Chain functions.
• Manage application upgrades, integrations, user support, and continuous improvement initiatives.
• Collaborate with regional teams on enterprise application projects and system enhancements.

Manufacturing Systems & Operational Technology

• Manage and support Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES), Warehouse Management Systems (WMS), and other manufacturing-related applications.
• Ensure seamless integration between ERP, MES, WMS, and operational systems.
• Partner with Production, Engineering, Quality, and Supply Chain teams to improve operational performance through technology solutions.
• Support production technology and shopfloor systems to ensure business continuity and operational efficiency.

Digital Transformation & Factory Automation

• Lead digital transformation initiatives across manufacturing operations.
• Identify opportunities to automate manual processes and improve operational efficiency through technology.
• Drive smart factory projects involving automation, IoT, machine connectivity, data analytics, and digital manufacturing solutions.
• Collaborate with business stakeholders to develop technology roadmaps supporting operational excellence and future growth.
• Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend solutions that improve productivity, quality, traceability, and cost efficiency.
• Promote a data-driven culture through real-time reporting, dashboards, and business intelligence solutions.
• Lead technology initiatives that enhance visibility across production, warehouse, inventory, and supply chain operations.

Cybersecurity & IT Governance

• Oversee cybersecurity programs, policies, and controls across the organization.
• Manage network security, firewalls, endpoint protection, access controls, and monitoring solutions.
• Ensure compliance with corporate IT standards and security requirements.
• Lead incident response, risk assessment, and mitigation activities.
• Maintain IT governance, documentation, and security best practices.

Project Management & Leadership

• Lead IT and digital transformation projects from planning through implementation and post-go-live support.
• Manage project scope, timelines, budgets, resources, and vendor performance.
• Work closely with local and regional stakeholders to ensure successful project delivery.
• Provide leadership, coaching, and technical guidance to IT team members and key users.

To apply online please click the 'Apply' button below. For a confidential discussion about this role please contact Gift Petto on +66 2 012 5067.

• Bachelor's Degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
• Minimum 8 years of experience in IT Infrastructure, Applications, Manufacturing Systems, or IT Management roles.
• Proven experience within manufacturing, food production, FMCG, logistics, or industrial environments.
• Strong experience supporting ERP platforms such as Microsoft Dynamics 365 or similar enterprise systems.
• Experience with MES, WMS, manufacturing technologies, or operational technology (OT) environments.
• Strong knowledge of network infrastructure, cloud technologies, virtualization, servers, and cybersecurity.
• Experience leading ERP, infrastructure, digital transformation, or factory automation projects.
• Strong project management and stakeholder management skills.
• Ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
• Good command of English.

Our client is an international player in consumer goods, currently transitioning from distributor to brand owner with products developed in Belgium.
 
#FMCG #InternationalSales #BrandLaunch #ScaleUp #Entrepreneurship

Jobomschrijving

The key responsibilities are:

• Develop and expand export markets outside Western Europe
• Build and manage relationships with international distributors and key accounts
• Drive sales growth and implement commercial strategies
• Negotiate contracts with retail chains, discounters and specialised stores
• Collaborate with agents across different regions
• Analyse market trends and identify new business opportunities
• Work closely with internal teams (marketing, supply chain, product)
• Travel internationally (±50%)

The profile that we are looking: 

You combine a business development mindset with strong account management skills:

• Experience in FMCG / consumer goods
• Strong B2B sales background
• Proven experience in international sales and distribution
• Experience working with agents is a plus
• Hands-on, entrepreneurial and results-driven
• Familiar with CRM systems
• Fluent in English (other languages are a plus)
• Willing to travel frequently
• Comfortable in a dynamic, growing SME environment

Bedrijfsomschrijving 

This company (re)packs and stores frozen and refrigerated food products for numerous European companies. They do this for each customer. By 2027, the company aims to have 300+ employees working on 25 000 unique packaging assignments. Working in this company means working in a respectful environment, where a great bond between employees and dedication to work go hand in hand.

As an operator, you will be responsible for 1 of 2 automatic packaging lines.

 
• 
You carry out checks on the food products that are introduced.

 
• 
You also set various parameters so that the right product ends up in the right packaging.

 
• 
Furthermore, you have to monitor the smooth operation of your packaging line.

 
• 
In case of technical failures, you are the first person who tries to solve this. For major malfunctions, you coordinate with the person in charge.

 
• 
The checks on the finished product are also done by you.

 
• 
All this in a team with a co-operator and 2 forklift drivers.

Read on quickly below and find out if you qualify:

 
• 
You have experience in setting up machines (it is a vertical packaging machine).

 
• 
You have a good technical knowledge.

 
• 
You speak good English and Dutch

 
• 
Experience as a forklift operator or forklift certificate is a plus.

 
• 
You highly value safety.

You will work on the production line.

• You fill food products.

• You check if the weight is correct.

• You take products off the production line.

• You place products in boxes.

• You put the correct labels on the products.

• You check that everything is correct.

• You keep your work area clean and tidy.

• You follow the rules for hygiene and food safety.

• You work together with your colleagues to make sure the work is finished on time.

We are looking for someone who:

• speaks Dutch. Good French or English is also possible

• likes to work and stay active : likes working with their hands

• can work accurately

• follows hygiene rules

• has no problem working in a cold environment of 0°C to 4°C

• has no problem with physical work

• is flexible when the work takes a little longer. It can happen that the work is not finished at the planned end time. In that case, you continue working until everything is finished;
is willing to work full-time.

• Experience in a production environment is a plus, but not required. No experience? No problem, you will learn the job on site.

Experience with an electric pallet truck or forklift is a plus. A valid certificate is an extra advantage.

Working hours

Monday to Thursday: 07:30 – 16:00

Friday: 07:30 – 13:30

For some positions, for example in the kitchen, the working day can start at 03:00 and finish at 11:30. Interested in this option? Let us know.

Are you flexible and able to work on Saturdays when needed? That is definitely a plus.

Welcome to Traxial: Where big ideas start small (but mighty)
 

Join Traxial as a 
Mechanical Design Engineer – Robotics and help shape compact, high-performance actuators for robotics. You’ll translate demanding motion requirements into practical, manufacturable mechanical designs. 
 

This is what you’ll do: 
 
 

•  

Design and develop mechanical solutions for robotic systems, from concept through prototype and production. 
   
 

•  

Create detailed 3D CAD models and 2D manufacturing drawings, applying relevant industry standards and GD&T. 
   
 

•  

Perform and support mechanical calculations and design verification to ensure performance, reliability, and durability. 
   
 

•  

Work closely with suppliers and subcontractors on components, manufacturing processes, tolerances, materials, and specifications. 
   
 

•  

Support prototype builds, testing, troubleshooting, and continuous design improvement. 
  

Who are we looking for? 
 
 

•  

Master’s degree in Mechanical or Electro-Mechanical Engineering, or equivalent experience. 
   
 

•  

At least 3 years of professional experience in the design and development of robotic systems, actuators, or precision motion systems. 
   
 

•  

Proficient in Siemens NX, Teamcenter PDM, or similar CAD/PDM tools. 
   
 

•  

Strong understanding of robotics system requirements and performance specifications, with the ability to translate payload, speed, torque, force, power, accuracy and duty cycle into mechanical design requirements. 
   
 

•  

Strong awareness of the latest trends and technologies in robotics, with a good understanding of emerging robotic architectures, actuation technologies, and motion solutions. 
   
 

•  

This position requires existing work authorization in Belgium. 
   
 

•  

A team player with a can-do mentality, creative mindset, and fluent English.

Welcome to Traxial: Where big ideas start small (but mighty)
 

Join Traxial as a Mechanical Design Engineer and take ownership for Precision Gearboxes . You'll work from concept to prototype and production, combining detailed mechanical design with hands-on validation.
 

This is what you'll do:
 
 

•  

Design and develop precision gearboxes for new product applications, from concept through prototype and production.
   
 

•  

Design mechanical components such as gears, shafts, bearings, housings, seals, and other transmission elements.
   
 

•  

Create detailed 3D CAD models and 2D manufacturing drawings, applying relevant industry standards and GD&T.
   
 

•  

Perform and support mechanical calculations and design verification.
   
 

•  

Work closely with suppliers and subcontractors on gearbox components, manufacturing processes, tolerances, materials, and specifications.
  

•  

Support prototype builds, testing, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement of gearbox and actuator designs.
  

Who are we looking for?
 
 

•  

Master's degree in Mechanical or Electro-Mechanical Engineering, or equivalent experience.
   
 

•  

At least 3 years of professional experience in gearbox, drivetrain or precision mechanical component design.
   
 

•  

Proficient in Siemens NX, Teamcenter PDM, or similar CAD/PDM tools.
   
 

•  

Good knowledge of materials and manufacturing processes for gearbox components, including gear machining, heat treatment, tolerancing, and design-for-manufacturing principles.
   
 

•  

Strong analytical skills and experience performing mechanical calculations, such as gear sizing, shaft strength and bearing selection.
   
 

•  

Experience in Romax, KISSsoft or similar packages for gear calculation is a plus.
   
 

•  

This position requires existing work authorization in Belgium.
   
 

•  

A team player with a can-do mentality, creative mindset, and fluent English.

As a production worker early shift, you play a key role in the production process of meat products. Together with your colleagues, you help ensure everything runs smoothly and efficiently.

Your responsibilities include:

 
• Supplying the production line with meat products.
 
• Trimming and cutting meat where necessary to ensure every product meets quality standards.
 
• No knife experience? No problem! Full training is provided on the job.
 
• Assisting with the loading and unloading of goods.
 
• Supporting different departments such as production, packaging, and dispatch.

The variety of tasks makes the role of production worker early shift both dynamic and rewarding.

Do you enjoy hands-on work and staying active throughout the day? Then you could be the production worker early shift we are looking for.

 
• Physically fit and comfortable with manual work.
 
• Willing to work with meat products.
 
• Comfortable working in a chilled environment.
 
• Able to work independently as well as part of a team.
 
• Flexible with early morning starts and shift schedules.
 
• As a production worker early shift, you can communicate in Dutch, English, French, and/or Romanian.

This large Belgian company plays a key role and manages an extensive and technically complex network. Behind the scenes, high-performing and reliable IT systems ensure that operational processes run safely and efficiently. Within this business-critical environment, significant investments are being made in modern software development and sustainable IT architecture.
You will join an experienced team operating in an Enterprise environment where quality, collaboration, and long-term vision are central.

You will work as part of a team on the further development and optimization of applications using a modern version of .NET & Angular, with a strong focus on performance, testing, and clean code. You ensure stable communication between various internal systems.
Beyond your operational involvement, you will also have input into the broader technical direction. Within the team, you will have the opportunity to initiate technical improvements and actively contribute to building a robust and future-proof IT environment.

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in IT (or equivalent through strong experience)
• Senior professional experience with .NET
• At least a first hands-on experience with Angular
• You're a pragmatic team player
• You work in English and understand Dutch & French

Our client, located in the Kortrijk region, is a global producer of textile machinery.

No two days are exactly the same. As a CNC Turner/Miller, you can expect the following responsibilities:

You set up and operate CNC turning and milling machines with the required precision. Throughout the production process, you monitor the automated machines closely and make adjustments whenever necessary.

Quality is key: you check finished parts and ensure they meet the required standards. You also review measurement results, identify deviations and communicate them to the responsible person.

By monitoring the automatic operation of the production cell, you help prevent downtime and ensure a smooth production flow.

 
• 
You have a strong technical interest and work with precision.

 
• 
You have an eye for quality and detail.

 
• 
You have experience with Fanuc and Mazak systems.

 
• 
You have previous experience in the metal industry as a turner/miller.

 
• 
You enjoy working in a team, while also being able to work independently.

 
• 
You are willing to work in a two-shift system: 5 a.m. – 1 p.m. and 1 p.m. – 9 p.m.

 
• 
You have a good knowledge of Dutch, French or English to follow the training successfully.
